items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png) # 🇺🇾 Hay un límite de 10 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28208-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28209-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 10. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28208-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsBLDTimeOpen2023#28209-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: Nikita Kovalchuk Memorial 2023
items.information: [UA] Змагання проводяться в памʼять про нашого доброго друга, професійного кубера і рекордсмена України — Нікіту Ковальчука (2015KOVA07). Він зробив великий вклад в розвиток та популяризацію українського швидкубінгу. На честь Нікіти учасниками буде складено портрет-мозаїку та проведено його улюблені дисципліни. Всі відвідувачі змагань мають обов’язково ознайомитись з розділом "[Запобіжні заходи](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NikitaKovalchukMemorial2023#28495-safety-measures)". Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/kubikinua). [ENG] The competition is held in memory of our good friend, professional speedcuber and a National Record holder — Nikita Kovalchuk (2015KOVA07). He made a great contribution to the development and popularisation of Ukrainian speedcubing. In honor of Nikita, the participants will make a mosaic portrait and compete in his favorite events. All visitors MUST read the section "[Safety measures](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NikitaKovalchukMemorial2023#28495-safety-measures)" carefully. Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/kubikinua).

items.information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Note that 3x3 speedsolving will NOT be held at this competition. If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held, please look for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?event_ids%255B%255D=333&region=_North+America&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). ***Event start times may change depending on registration totals. Competitors will be notified about changes after registration has closed.*** You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case Spectators can attend for free. Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a maximum of 1 guest each. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Try Not To DNF Rzeszów 2023

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors

items.information: Pierwsze zawody z big blindami w Rzeszowie! Zwróć uwagę, że na tych zawodach NIE będą organizowane standardowe konkurencje takie jak 3x3. Drugie rundy odbędą się jedynie jeżeli w danej konkurencji weźmie udział 8 zawodników. Zawody odbędą się w Rzeszowie, w dzielnicy Wilkowyja, w pobliżu wypożyczalni sprzętu budowlanego RENTA. Dokładny adres zawodów zostanie podany zarejestrowanym zawodnikom. Wszystkie informacje na poszczególne tematy odnoszące się zawodów można znaleźć w odpowiednich zakładkach. W razie pytań należy kontaktować się z organizatorami. --------- The first competition with big blinds in Rzeszów! Please note that standard events such as 3x3 will NOT be held at this event. Second rounds will only take place if 8 competitors participate in a given event. The competition will take place in Rzeszów, in the Wilkowyja district, near the RENTA construction equipment rental. The exact address of the competition will be given to registered competitors All information on individual topics related to the competition can be found in the appropriate tabs. If you have any questions, please contact the organizers.
